# dsh-model **📅 Daily check-in credits claimed for you (10 products, plus your own) · 🆓 a free pool: one key for every provider's official free quota · 🔁 one address that relays every model · 🧩 36 sources** Install once and all of this is taken care of. dsh gets a management page; without dsh, the command line does everything.

English · [中文](README.md)
## ✅ Why dsh-model | | dsh-model | Typical "free model" plugins | |---|---|---| | How models are connected | Each vendor's **official** API and proper subscription sign-ins | IDE clients' private APIs, some rewriting requests to get past the vendor's blocking | | Account safety | **No rewritten requests, no getting around a vendor's blocking**: if a vendor blocks it, we stop | Breaks when the vendor changes its protocol; accounts can be banned | | Where it works | One address for dsh, editors, scripts and other computers | Mostly inside dsh only | | Sources | **36**: free, subscription, local and pay as you go, plus your own | A dozen or so account channels | | Free quota | **Free pool** `free/auto`: official free quotas combined, soon-to-expire first, **anything that charges stays out by default** | — | | Check-in | Trae, Qoder, WorkBuddy, Doubao, OfficeAce, MiniMax Code, WPS Lingxi, DuMate, AStudio, Huawei CodeArts, plus **your own custom services**; **several accounts each**, can run on an always-on VPS | Some | | Install | Installing from the plugin marketplace **sets itself up**; no GitHub needed in China | Restart dsh after installing | | Transparency | No server of our own, no telemetry; every address it talks to is in the [egress list](docs/EGRESS.md) | — | ## 📅 1. Daily check-in: credits land on their own **The most hands-off part: no more remembering to claim the daily check-in credits.** | Product | How it connects | Every day | |---|---|---| | **Trae** | Detected automatically if Trae is installed and signed in; nothing to do | Check-in credits (200 a day in testing) | | **Qoder** | Paste a personal access token once (China or international) | That day's check-in credits | | **WorkBuddy (China)** | Sign in once (several accounts are fine) | Check-in credits | | **Doubao** (experimental) | On Mac / Windows click "Read from this computer" to use the account signed in to the Doubao app or a browser; or paste the cookie by hand (personal accounts only) | Daily trial credits | | **OfficeAce** (Huawei Cloud, experimental) | Click "+ Add OfficeAce" and sign in to Huawei Cloud in the browser (works on a VPS too) | Daily points | | **MiniMax Code** | Detected automatically if installed and signed in | Check-in credits (400 a day) | | **WPS Lingxi** | Detected automatically if installed and signed in (Node ≥ 22.5) | Points (100 a day, 200 from day 7) | | **Baidu DuMate** | Detected automatically if installed and signed in | Check-in credits | | **AStudio** | Detected automatically if installed and signed in | Daily sign-in credits | | **Huawei CodeArts** | Click "+ Sign in to Huawei CodeArts" and sign in in the browser (the browser must be on this computer); paste AK/SK on a VPS | Check-in points | | **Your own** | "+ Custom check-in service": copy the prompt so the dsh AI looks up the API, paste back its JSON, then paste the Cookie / token | Depends on the service | - **Automatic by default**: done at a random 5–55 minutes after midnight Beijing time; failures retry an hour later; if the computer was off, it catches up within a minute of starting. - **You can see it**: one line at the top of the settings page, "Checked in today: …", with a one-click "Check in all" for anything missed, plus a one-time notice in the corner of dsh. - **What else this machine can do**: the card lists the supported products not set up here yet, each with "+ Add". - **Move it to an always-on VPS**: "Copy check-in accounts to another machine" gives an encrypted text and a code to import on the VPS page (Qoder and Doubao; sign in to WorkBuddy and OfficeAce on the VPS itself, and Trae stays on the computer that has Trae). - **Several accounts**: each product can have more than one. In the check-in card's Details: "+ Add a WorkBuddy account" (approve through a link) and "+ Add another Qoder account"; several Trae installs are checked in once per account automatically. - **Paste credentials, check in from a VPS**: Lingxi, DuMate, AStudio, CodeArts and your custom services take a pasted Cookie / token under "+ Paste check-in credentials" (several accounts each), so the app does not have to be on that machine. - **Check-in only, credits untouched**: they stay on your account for use in each product's own app. Command line: `dsh-model checkin`. ## 🔁 2. Relay: one address, one key, every model Your model sources each have their own API and sign-in. dsh-model puts them behind **one OpenAI-compatible address**: - **Shows up in dsh**: every model, grouped by source, with nothing to configure. - **Works in other tools**: Cline, Continue, Cherry Studio, scripts: anything that speaks the OpenAI API uses the same address and key. - **Rate limits are not the end**: build a combo (say Codex → Kimi → Gemini) and the next model takes over on a rate limit, used-up quota or error. - **Know where you stand**: plan usage with reset countdowns; success rate, latency, speed, token usage and cache hits per model; a "Recent requests" log where failed rows say why and what to do; and a notice when quota runs low. - **Secure by default**: a key is always required, one per device, revocable any time; every sign-in happens on your own machine. - **Laptop or server**: Windows, macOS, Linux; on a VPS (with [dsh-vps](https://github.com/AIcivilization/dsh-vps)) it opens an https address you can use from anywhere. Uninstall restores dsh's config byte for byte. ## 🆓 Free pool: one key for every provider's official free quota ModelScope's daily free calls, Cloudflare's daily Neurons, OpenRouter's `:free` models, the free models of Zhipu / Spark / Qianfan / Hunyuan, the free tiers of Gemini and Groq… they all exist, spread over a dozen platforms. dsh-model turns them into **three models**: | Model | Uses | |---|---| | `free/auto` | every free model, stronger ones first | | `free/smart` | large models only | | `free/fast` | small, fast models only | - **Soon-to-expire first**: daily quotas → monthly → ones with an end date → always-free → local models as the last resort. - **Moves on when one runs out**: a provider that hits its limit cools down until it resets (daily ones at midnight Beijing time, monthly ones on the 1st) and the next one takes over. - **Never spends your money**: new-user vouchers and quotas that "switch to pay as you go" stay **out** of the pool; to add one you set a token cap, and it is taken out at 90%. - **See what is left to claim**: the "Free quota" card lists every quota (cycle, amount, requirements, end date, value), with "Claim" to open the official page and "Add key" to put it in the pool. - **Finds new ones**: once a day it checks the quota catalog for new entries and connected platforms for new free models, and **asks you** before adding. - **Add your own**: any OpenAI-compatible service, as many as you like; tick "free quota" and it joins the pool. Check-in credits that only work inside a product (Trae, Qoder, MiniMax Code…) never go through the key; the check-in above claims them. Command line: `dsh-model free`. ## 🧩 3. Models: free or subscription, connect what you have | Kind | Sources | |---|---| | **Free (suggested)** | **SiliconFlow** (reachable from China; some models free after identity verification), **Gemini** (if you can reach Google; the best free models) | | Free · limited | **ModelScope** (about 2,000 calls a day), **Zhipu GLM** (the Flash models), **iFlytek Spark** (Spark Lite), Tencent Hunyuan (hunyuan-lite), Baidu Qianfan (ERNIE Speed / Lite), Mistral, NVIDIA, Groq, OpenRouter (`:free` models) | | Local | Ollama, LM Studio: appear once started, no sign-in | | Subscription | Codex (ChatGPT Plus / Pro), Kimi Code, Grok, Muse, Devin: sign in from the management page | | Free · daily | **Cloudflare Workers AI** (10,000 Neurons a day, stops when used up), **InternLM** (monthly credits during the beta) | | New-user / monthly credits (charge once used up) | SCNet (100M tokens), Ant Ling (¥10 a month), Tencent Cloud TokenHub (1M tokens), Alibaba Cloud Bailian, Volcengine Ark | | Pay as you go | DeepSeek official, Alibaba Cloud Bailian (new users get about 1M free tokens per model), Moonshot, StepFun, Volcengine Ark, MiniMax, Huawei Cloud ModelArts, OpenCode Zen, any OpenAI-compatible service (add several) | Every source is tagged Free / Free · limited / Paid; see [Sources and cost](#sources-and-cost) below. dsh-model only connects; it provides no quota of its own. > WorkBuddy: since 2026-10 it recognises conversations sent by dsh and blocks them, so dsh-model uses it for check-in only and does not connect its models by default. ## Quick start ```bash npm install -g dsh-model dsh-model setup ``` On a dsh-vps server, use `sudo dsh-model setup`. On Windows, run it in a normal PowerShell or Command Prompt; no administrator rights needed. `setup` is safe to re-run. It: 1. downloads and verifies the engine and runs it on `127.0.0.1:8317/v1`, with key auth enforced; 2. starts dsh-model's daemon (the management page, check-in and sign-ins run on it). Setup asks for no keys: for a free source we suggest **SiliconFlow** (reachable from China) or **Gemini** (if you can reach Google), added from the management page. WorkBuddy is used for check-in only; its models are not connected to dsh by default; 3. installs the management page into dsh and syncs the models into dsh; 4. on a VPS, also opens a public address `https://:9443/v1` (or `.sslip.io` when there is no domain). ## Manage it in dsh: Settings → dsh-model | Section | What it holds | |---|---| | **Daily check-in** | 10 products checked in automatically every day (or with one click); the card shows what you got today | | **Free quota** | Which models are in the `free/auto` pool and the state of each quota (in use / cooling until / charges, not in the pool / not claimed), with "Claim", "Add key", "Look for new" and "+ Add a source" | | **Endpoint** | Local and public addresses, each with a Copy button | | **Sources** | One switch per provider: on connects (and signs in if needed), off pauses and keeps the sign-in. Each row is tagged Free / Free · limited / Paid and shows plan usage with reset countdowns, or remaining credits and the next batch to expire; a used-up plan shows when it comes back | | **Models** | Pick which models of each source appear in dsh (5 suggested per source by default); the rest stay available through the endpoint; a "Test" button per model | | **Combos** | Put several models in order and it becomes one model in dsh: the first is used, and the next takes over on a rate limit, used-up quota or error. Other tools use the model name `combo/` | | **Auto switch** | When a model is offered by several sources, dsh gets an "Auto switch (multiple sources)" group that moves to another source when one is rate-limited or failing | | **Recent failures** | Failed requests in the last 24 hours: which model, why, and what to do (no conversation content kept) | | **API keys** | OpenAI-style, one per device. Requests, success rate, latency and speed over 24 hours; copy, rotate, revoke | | **Model stats** | Success rate, latency and speed per model | | **About** | Current and latest npm version; one-click Update and Uninstall (on a VPS these need root, so the commands are shown instead) | After installing from the plugin marketplace, dsh-model sets itself up in the background as soon as dsh loads the plugin (the engine comes with npm, no GitHub needed), in about a minute; open this page to watch the progress, see why it failed, or click "Set up now" to try again. A machine where you ran `dsh-model uninstall` is not set up again automatically. A "Getting started" guide appears on a fresh install; a banner shows when the plugin was updated but dsh not restarted (one-click restart on dsh-vps); a low-quota notice appears in the corner of any dsh page. So installing dsh-model from the dsh plugin marketplace and opening this page is all it takes. dsh-model does every sign-in itself. No provider CLI is installed and the server needs no browser: - **WorkBuddy, Codex, Kimi, Grok, Muse**: open the link and approve; if a code is needed, the dialog shows it; - **Devin, Claude, Antigravity**: these send the browser to a fixed local address that will not load. That is expected: bring the address back and press "Paste from clipboard". If a source is signed in but has no usable plan (say, a Kimi account without Kimi Code), dsh-model detects it, hides its models in dsh and shows where to subscribe. > After updating dsh-model, restart dsh once so the management page picks up the new code. Model and switch changes need no restart. ## Sources and cost | Source | Cost | Notes | |---|---|---| | WorkBuddy / WorkBuddy AI | Free | Credits come with the account. **Since 2026-10 WorkBuddy recognises conversations sent by dsh and blocks them**, so it barely works inside dsh; check-in still works | | Ollama / LM Studio | Free | Models running on this machine; they appear once installed and started, no sign-in | | Gemini (Google AI Studio), Groq | Free · limited | Paste a free API key; daily / per-minute limits apply | | OpenRouter | Free · limited | `:free` models are free (about 50 requests a day) | | SiliconFlow | Free · limited | Some small models are free after identity verification | | Zhipu GLM | Free · limited | The Flash models (e.g. GLM-4.7-Flash) are free; reachable from China | | iFlytek Spark | Free · limited | Spark Lite is free with no token cap, 2 requests per second; use the console's APIPassword as the key | | Baidu Qianfan | Free · limited | ERNIE Speed / Lite are free for now (rate limited) | | ModelScope | Free · limited | About 2,000 calls a day (each model has its own cap; resets at midnight Beijing time); link an Alibaba Cloud account first and use your ModelScope access token | | Tencent Hunyuan | Free · limited | hunyuan-lite is free (limited concurrency); new users get some free tokens | | Mistral | Free · limited | Free Experiment plan with a verified phone number; free-tier requests may be used for training | | NVIDIA (build.nvidia.com) | Free · limited | Free developer trial, rate limited per minute | | Alibaba Cloud Bailian, Moonshot, StepFun | Paid | Official APIs; Bailian gives new users about 1M free tokens per model (Beijing region, about 90 days) | | Volcengine Ark (Doubao models), MiniMax, Huawei Cloud ModelArts | Paid | Official APIs, just add a key; Ark and Huawei Cloud have free quotas for new users | | Cloudflare Workers AI | Free · limited | 10,000 Neurons a day on the free plan, stops (no charge) when used up; the URL includes your account ID | | InternLM | Free · limited | Monthly credits during the beta | | SCNet, Ant Ling, Tencent Cloud TokenHub | Paid | New-user / monthly credits, then your balance, so they stay out of the free pool by default | | DeepSeek official, any OpenAI-compatible service | Paid | Paste an API key (and a URL for other services; add several, tick "free quota" to put one in the pool) | | Codex | Paid | ChatGPT Plus / Pro | | Kimi | Paid | Kimi Code plan | | Grok | Paid | SuperGrok / X Premium+ | | Muse | Paid | Muse Code plan | | Devin | Paid | The free tier is refused in testing | | OpenCode Zen | Paid | Pay as you go after a top-up; its free models only work inside the OpenCode app | | Claude, Antigravity | High risk, hidden by default | The providers have banned third-party use before | dsh-model only connects; it provides no quota of its own. ## Commands | Command | What it does | |---|---| | `setup` | Install / repair everything (idempotent) | | `sources` | Sources: switch, cost, sign-in state, usage | | `source enable\|disable\|logout ` | Turn on (signing in if needed) / off / sign out | | `key list\|add\|revoke\|rotate ` | Access keys, one per device | | `checkin` | Check in now (10 products and your custom services; automatic daily by default) | | `free [discover\|optin \|optout \|add [--free ]]` | Free quota: overview, look for new ones, put a charging quota in the pool, add your own source | | `combo list\|add \|remove ` | Combos: try several models in order | | `failures` | Failed requests in the last 24 hours, with advice | | `stats` | Success rate, latency and speed by key, source and model | | `status` / `doctor [--e2e]` | Overview / health checks | | `models [sync]` | List models / sync them to dsh | | `remote enable --via caddy\|ssh\|tailscale` / `remote disable` | Remote access (on a VPS, setup already enables caddy) | | `engine version\|upgrade\|rollback` | Engine version | | `logs [--bridge]` / `repair` | Logs / repair | | `update [--to ver]` | Update to the latest npm version: program, dsh plugin and services together | | `uninstall` | Clean uninstall | Every command accepts `--lang zh|en` and `--json`. ## Architecture ``` dsh · editors · scripts ──Bearer key──▶ engine 127.0.0.1:8317/v1 (the only entry) │ ▲ VPS: Caddy https://:9443 ┌────────────────────────────┼─────────────────────────┐ ▼ ▼ ▼ subscription OAuth (Codex, Kimi…) opencode/* (your key) workbuddy/* → dsh-model's bridge ``` - The engine is [CLIProxyAPI](https://github.com/router-for-me/CLIProxyAPI) (MIT), version-pinned and sha256-verified. The WorkBuddy protocol layer is ported from [dsh-workbuddy-connect](https://github.com/corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect) (MIT); the usage endpoints follow [CodexBar](https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar) (MIT). - dsh-model writes only two things into dsh: the model providers and `refs.DSH_MODEL_API_KEY`. On uninstall they are restored byte for byte if nobody changed them. See the [design doc](docs/DESIGN.md) (Chinese). ## Notes - Meant for personal use: one account of your own per provider; do not use it to serve others. - Using subscription and WorkBuddy credentials outside the official clients may break the providers' terms and put the account at risk. Decide for yourself. - Windows 10 / 11 (x64, ARM64), macOS and Linux, Node ≥ 20. - The engine ships with npm, so no proxy is needed: the engine (CLIProxyAPI) is split into per-platform npm packages, and installing dsh-model pulls only the one for your platform (npm has mirrors in China), so setup no longer needs GitHub. Only when no package exists for your platform does it fall back to downloading from GitHub: setup then uses the system proxy (Windows, macOS) or `HTTPS_PROXY` automatically, and you can pass `--proxy ` or download the file yourself and set `DSH_MODEL_ENGINE_ARCHIVE`. - Windows: the background services start at sign-in with no window. If an antivirus blocks them (the program is gone or will not start), trust `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh-model` and run `dsh-model repair`. ## License MIT

常用命令 | 命令 | 作用 | |---|---| | `setup` | 安装 / 修复全部（可重复执行） | | `sources` | 来源列表：开关、费用、登录状态、用量 | | `source enable\|disable\|logout <来源>` | 打开（需要时登录）/ 关闭 / 退出登录 | | `key list\|add\|revoke\|rotate <名称>` | 访问 key，每台设备一把 | | `checkin` | 现在签到一次（10 家和自定义的服务；默认每天自动签） | | `free [discover\|optin <来源> <上限>\|optout <来源>\|add <名字> <地址> [--free <周期>]]` | 免费额度：总览、探测新额度、会扣钱的额度放进免费池、手动添加来源 | | `combo list\|add <名称> <模型…>\|remove ` | 组合切换：按顺序试几个模型 | | `failures` | 最近 24 小时失败的请求和建议 | | `stats` | 按 key、来源、模型的成功率、延迟和速度 | | `status` / `doctor [--e2e]` | 总览 / 逐项自检 | | `models [sync]` | 列出模型 / 同步到 dsh | | `remote enable --via caddy\|ssh\|tailscale` / `remote disable` | 远程访问（VPS 上 setup 已自动开通 caddy） | | `engine version\|upgrade\|rollback` | 引擎版本 | | `logs [--bridge]` / `repair` | 日志 / 修复 | | `update [--to 版本]` | 更新到 npm 上的最新版：程序、dsh 插件和服务一起更新 | | `uninstall` | 干净卸载 | 所有命令都支持 `--lang zh|en` 和 `--json`。 ## 架构 ``` dsh · 编辑器 · 脚本 ──Bearer key──▶ 引擎 127.0.0.1:8317/v1（唯一入口） │ ▲ VPS：Caddy https://:9443 ┌────────────────────────┼────────────────────────┐ ▼ ▼ ▼ 订阅 OAuth（Codex、Kimi…） opencode/*（你的 key） workbuddy/* → dsh-model 的 bridge ``` - 引擎是 [CLIProxyAPI](https://github.com/router-for-me/CLIProxyAPI)（MIT），版本锁定并校验 sha256。WorkBuddy 协议层移植自 [dsh-workbuddy-connect](https://github.com/corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect)（MIT），订阅用量的查询接口参考了 [CodexBar](https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar)（MIT）。 - dsh 里只写两样东西：模型 provider 和 `refs.DSH_MODEL_API_KEY`。卸载时，如果这两处没被改过，就逐字节还原。 详见 [设计文档](docs/DESIGN.md)。 ## 注意 - 适合个人使用：每家用自己的一个账号，不要拿来对外提供服务。 - 订阅和 WorkBuddy 的凭据在官方客户端之外使用，可能不符合服务商的条款，账号有风险，请自行判断。 - 支持 Windows 10 / 11（x64、ARM64）、macOS、Linux，需要 Node ≥ 20。 - 引擎随 npm 一起装，国内免代理：引擎（CLIProxyAPI）按平台拆成了几个 npm 包，装 dsh-model 时只把当前平台那一个带下来（npm 国内有镜像），setup 不用再连 GitHub。npm 上没有对应平台的包时，才回退到从 GitHub 下载：这时 setup 会自动用上系统代理（Windows、macOS）或 `HTTPS_PROXY`，也可以用 `--proxy <地址>` 指定代理，或手动下载后设置 `DSH_MODEL_ENGINE_ARCHIVE`。 - Windows：后台服务登录后自动运行、不弹窗口。如果被杀毒软件拦下（程序不见了或启动不了），把 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh-model` 加入信任，再执行 `dsh-model repair`。 ##
